title: Getting help
lede: Who to contact, in what order, and why you should not open a vendor ticket yourself.

blocks.title: OME files vendor tickets, not you
blocks.text: If something looks like an ExamSoft defect, send it to Jesse rather than contacting ExamSoft directly. Tickets from OME carry the institution context, the portal edition, and the account details the vendor asks for, so they get worked instead of bounced back for more information.

blocks.title: During an exam, the proctor comes first
blocks.text: Students are told not to troubleshoot on their own, and the same goes for you. The proctor holds the resume code and the hard copies. Escalate afterwards.

blocks.title: Check the title before you trust an article
blocks.text: Searching the support site returns Enterprise and Legacy versions of nearly every article, and they describe different screens. If the title does not start with **Legacy Portal**, or say explicitly that it covers both editions, it may not match what is in front of you.
